expected_root_cause_for_testing.note: This fixture intentionally has no known pattern in the catalog (a connection timeout, not schema mismatch or resource exhaustion). It exists to exercise the 'no common pattern -> no recommendation' acceptance criterion for STORY-001, and to give a later story (SQL/connectivity analysis) a real gap to fill.
